description: Bruno Clair's 2015 Morey-Saint-Denis Blanc En la Rue de Vergy is a mineral, tightly drawn Chardonnay from limestone soils above the village. Oak maturation adds breadth, but the wine's defining qualities are precision, aromatic range, and remarkable length.
imagePrompt: Photorealistic studio bottle photograph of a 2015 Domaine Bruno Clair Morey-Saint-Denis Blanc En la Rue de Vergy.
palate: Broad yet linear, mineral, finely oaked
sommelierNotes: Serve at 11-13°C and allow a little air; pair with turbot, roast poultry, lobster, or a restrained cream sauce.
